## Summary

<!--
What changed and why, in a short paragraph. Then bold-led bullets for the details.
Link related work: "Fixes #N" or "Stacked on #N."
-->

## Type of change

<!-- Check one. Needing more than one usually means the PR should be split. -->

- [ ] `feat`: a new feature
- [ ] `fix`: a bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` or `perf`: no change in behaviour
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`, `ci`, `build` or `chore`: tooling and upkeep

## Testing

<!--
Concrete bullets: the device or emulator scenario and what it showed, the test
classes added or changed, and the checks you ran (ktlint, host tests, debug build).
-->

## Screenshots

<!-- UI changes only: before and after, or a short recording for motion. Delete this section otherwise. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One feature, small enough to review in a few minutes
- [ ] Title is `type: summary`, without a `(#N)` suffix
- [ ] Tests added or updated where they make sense
- [ ] Docs updated, or not needed
- [ ] I understand every change and can explain it
- [ ] No tool attribution in commits or this description
